title: Parameterized Stripe Attention for Efficient Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.37001v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) enable high-quality video generation but suffer from substantial inference latency, primarily attributable to the computationally expensive full spatio-temporal attention. While sparse attention methods offer potential solutions, existing approaches face an inherent flexibility--efficiency dilemma: predefined masks lack the flexibility to capture diverse attention patterns, while runtime-determined masks introduce overheads and sacrifice hardware efficiency. We identify the lack of a unified structural characterization of DiT attention as a key limitation of existing methods, and establish that video DiT attention exhibits \textbf{periodic diagonal stripe structures} along both temporal and spatial dimensions. translated_title: 面向高效视频生成的参数化条纹注意力
translated_abstract: 扩散变换器能够实现高质量的视频生成，但其推理延迟显著，这主要归因于计算代价高昂的完整时空注意力机制。尽管稀疏注意力方法提供了潜在的解决方案，但现有方法面临固有的灵活性—效率困境：预定义的掩码缺乏捕捉多样化注意力模式的灵活性，而运行时确定的掩码则会引入额外开销并牺牲硬件效率。我们将缺乏对DiT注意力的统一结构表征确定为现有方法的关键局限，并证实视频DiT注意力在时间和空间维度上均表现出周期性的对角条纹结构。为了在单个高效内核中正式编码这些结构化模式，我们提出了PSA——一种参数化条纹注意力，它将观察到的条纹规律性形式化，统一了多种……（原文摘要不完整）
tldr: 本文提出参数化条纹注意力PSA，通过形式化视频DiT注意力中周期性对角条纹结构，在单一高效内核中统一编码多种注意力模式，从而解决稀疏注意力方法灵活性—效率两难的问题，加速视频生成。
en_tdlr: PSA is a parameterized stripe attention that formalizes the periodic diagonal stripe structures in video DiT attention, unifying diverse attention patterns within a single efficient kernel to resolve the flexibility-efficiency dilemma of sparse attention and accelerate video generation.
